metadata.description: blueboard: Sentinel analytics rule (limit-hit). Fires when an agent or principal hits board rate limits or per-incident pending action caps.
Log Analytics workspace with Microsoft Sentinel enabled

properties.displayName: blueboard: principal hit rate limit or pending action cap
properties.description: An agent or analyst hit the board's per-principal rate limit or pending-actions-per-incident cap. Could indicate a looping or prompt-injected agent trying to flood hunts or containment requests.
properties.query:
BlueboardAudit_CL
| where Event == "limit.hit"
| extend Bucket = tostring(Detail.bucket)
| summarize Hits = count(), Buckets = make_set(Bucket, 20) by Actor, ActorKind, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where ActorKind == "agent" or Hits >= 3 or Buckets has_any ("action_request", "pending_actions_per_incident")
